overall_summary: Data indicates family relationships and close interpersonal bonds (wife, mother, relationships) significantly outperform general emotional or standalone family tropes. The video about husband-wife dynamics ("or5gtaBpRVY") received the highest views (1655), while relationship realities ("NO5fdHLxFL4") also performed decently. Confidence remains low due to small sample size and zero comments across all videos.

winning_patterns.pattern: Core family and marital relationship dynamics
winning_patterns.evidence: Wife emotional video ("or5gtaBpRVY") reached 1655 views, and Mother emotional video ("OfHrAp3r1G8") reached 225 views.
winning_patterns.action: Focus heavily on everyday marital, parental, and close relationship compromises.
Use conversational hooks that highlight hidden relationship burdens.

weak_patterns.pattern: Standalone sibling tropes without a strong narrative hook
weak_patterns.evidence: Sister emotional video ("jfmMztnam_A") stagnated at 18 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic statements about siblings; ground them in specific situational conflicts.

weak_patterns.pattern: Vague self-motivation and ungrounded life lessons
weak_patterns.evidence: Self motivation video ("JPf_3ebfnuk") underperformed with 171 views compared to relationship content.
weak_patterns.action: Tie motivational thoughts directly to specific relationship struggles rather than generic advice.
